command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP 1: create backing image and btrfs filesystem"
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/antrieb-btrfs
if [ ! -f /var/lib/antrieb-btrfs/srv-data.img ]; then
  sudo -n fallocate -l 2G /var/lib/antrieb-btrfs/srv-data.img || sudo -n dd if=/dev/zero of=/var/lib/antrieb-btrfs/srv-data.img bs=1M count=2048
  sudo -n mkfs.btrfs -q -L srvdata /var/lib/antrieb-btrfs/srv-data.img
fi

echo "STEP 2: mount btrfs top-level volume"
sudo -n mkdir -p /mnt/srv-btrfs
if ! mountpoint -q /mnt/srv-btrfs; then
  sudo -n mount -o loop /var/lib/antrieb-btrfs/srv-data.img /mnt/srv-btrfs
fi

echo "STEP 3: create data subvolume and snapshots dir if absent"
if [ ! -d /mnt/srv-btrfs/data ]; then
  sudo -n btrfs subvolume create /mnt/srv-btrfs/data
fi
sudo -n mkdir -p /mnt/srv-btrfs/snapshots

echo "STEP 4: mount data subvolume at /srv/data"
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
if ! mountpoint -q /srv/data; then
  sudo -n mount --bind /mnt/srv-btrfs/data /srv/data
fi

echo "STEP 5: persist mounts via fstab (idempotent)"
IMG=/var/lib/antrieb-btrfs/srv-data.img
grep -q "$IMG /mnt/srv-btrfs" /etc/fstab || echo "$IMG /mnt/srv-btrfs btrfs loop,defaults 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
grep -q "/mnt/srv-btrfs/data /srv/data" /etc/fstab || echo "/mnt/srv-btrfs/data /srv/data none bind 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab

echo "STEP 6: populate baseline application data"
sudo -n rm -rf /srv/data/*
sudo -n sh -c 'cat > /srv/data/app.conf <<EOF
service=antrieb-app
mode=production
version=1.0
EOF'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "record-1,record-2,record-3" > /srv/data/records.csv'
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data/logs
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "baseline log entry" > /srv/data/logs/app.log'

echo "STEP 7: checksum baseline"
sudo -n sh -c 'cd /srv/data && find . -type f -exec sha256sum {} \;' | sort > /tmp/baseline.sha256
cat /tmp/baseline.sha256

echo "STEP 8: take read-only snapshot 'baseline'"
sudo -n rm -rf /mnt/srv-btrfs/snapshots/baseline
sudo -n btrfs subvolume snapshot -r /srv/data /mnt/srv-btrfs/snapshots/baseline

echo "STEP 9: verify snapshot content matches baseline"
sudo -n sh -c 'cd /mnt/srv-btrfs/snapshots/baseline && find . -type f -exec sha256sum {} \;' | sort > /tmp/snapshot.sha256
diff /tmp/baseline.sha256 /tmp/snapshot.sha256 && echo "SNAPSHOT MATCHES BASELINE: OK"

echo "STEP 10: modify /srv/data (simulate change/corruption)"
sudo -n rm -f /srv/data/records.csv
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "CORRUPTED" > /srv/data/app.conf'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "unexpected file" > /srv/data/intruder.txt'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "tampered" >> /srv/data/logs/app.log'
echo "post-modification listing:"
sudo -n find /srv/data -type f | sort

echo "STEP 11: checksum of modified state (expected to differ)"
sudo -n sh -c 'cd /srv/data && find . -type f -exec sha256sum {} \;' | sort > /tmp/modified.sha256
diff /tmp/baseline.sha256 /tmp/modified.sha256 && echo "UNEXPECTED: no diff" || echo "CONFIRMED DIVERGENCE FROM BASELINE"

echo "STEP 12: restore /srv/data from baseline snapshot"
sudo -n umount /srv/data
sudo -n btrfs subvolume delete /mnt/srv-btrfs/data
sudo -n btrfs subvolume snapshot /mnt/srv-btrfs/snapshots/baseline /mnt/srv-btrfs/data
sudo -n mount --bind /mnt/srv-btrfs/data /srv/data

echo "STEP 13: verify restored content matches original baseline exactly"
sudo -n sh -c 'cd /srv/data && find . -type f -exec sha256sum {} \;' | sort > /tmp/restored.sha256
diff /tmp/baseline.sha256 /tmp/restored.sha256 && echo "RESTORE VERIFIED: CONTENT MATCHES BASELINE EXACTLY"
echo "restored listing:"
sudo -n find /srv/data -type f | sort
